tweets.author: @svpino
tweets.text:
This is a new model that specializes in 3D rendering and geometry.

You give it an image and a rough 3D mesh, and it creates a more detailed 3D shape.

The model was trained on 2 million 3D assets, which is a ton of data! This is probably why it can generate pretty good results.
